name: Memory (oomd)
author: Arnaldo Delisio (fork of EGOIST's omarchy-memory-usage)
description: Memory usage bar widget that knows about systemd-oomd: kill-line levels, per-app memory by cgroup, and warnings before an app is killed.

barWidget.description: Live RAM usage, PSI pressure, distance to the systemd-oomd kill lines, and per-app memory by cgroup.

schema.label: Icon size
schema.description: Size of the RAM chip icon in the bar, in pixels. The bar's standard icon size is 13.

schema.label: Panel list
schema.description: Show apps grouped by cgroup (the units systemd-oomd kills), processes grouped by executable name, or both.

schema.label: App rows
schema.description: Number of app rows in the panel.

schema.label: Process rows
schema.description: Number of process rows in the panel.

schema.label: Notify when memory gets tight
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when the level enters warn or critical. Critical names the largest app oomd could kill.

schema.label: Notification cooldown (seconds)
schema.description: Minimum time between two notifications for the same level.

schema.label: Swap warn margin (points)
schema.description: Warn when swap used is within this many percentage points of the oomd swap limit.

schema.label: Swap critical margin (points)
schema.description: Critical when swap used is within this many percentage points of the oomd swap limit.

schema.label: Pressure warn (% of limit)
schema.description: Warn when app.slice pressure reaches this percent of the oomd pressure limit.

schema.label: Pressure critical hold (% of duration)
schema.description: Critical when pressure stays at or above the limit for this percent of the oomd duration.
